name: Buddy
description: Rick's talking station wagon in Night Wagon: calm, wise and literal. His face is the dashboard's buttons, which pulse when he speaks.

look.description: a boxy beige 1980s American station wagon with wood-panelled sides and a red scanner light sweeping across its front grille; inside, a dashboard with rows of chunky lit red, yellow and green buttons and one big red button
never: a face, smiley, voice bar or waveform
any lettering on the car or dashboard

stills.note: three-quarter front at the broken bridge, scanner on the grille (Take 9's halt)
his face: the dashboard buttons, Rick's hands on the wheel behind (Take 9)

voice.name: Bill - Wise, Mature, Balanced
voice.notes: Voice-only: his lines are text-to-speech over shots where only the dashboard lights move.

delivery.register: calm, measured and wise, gently literal, never alarmed

levels.source: Buddy's lines in the approved Night Wagon Take 9

lines.text: The bridge ahead is out, Rick.

changelog.changes: First version: look from the Night Wagon storyboards, voice from gens.log (every Buddy line is "Bill - Wise, Mature, Balanced"). Reference levels measured from 5 approved lines (Buddy's lines in the approved Night Wagon Take 9): -32.0 to -22.6 LUFS, 100 to 300 Hz, pitch range up to 16.6 st, 1.70 to 5.15 words/s.
